```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(readr)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)



```


```{r read-sample}



file_path <- "Canada_main_MC_MCMC_sample.tab"  # written by Canada_main_MC.cmd in this folder

# Read the tab-separated file
df <- fread(file_path, check.names = FALSE)



```


```{r }




# Replace dots in column names with spaces or underscores
new_column_names <- gsub("\\.", " ", names(df))
setnames(df, new_column_names)

# Set sample size
sample_size <- 5000

# Random sampling (seed fixed so the same 5,000 draws are selected every time)
set.seed(1)
df_sample <- df[sample(.N, sample_size)]


# Clean again after sampling (extra safety)
df_sample <- df_sample[, which(colSums(!is.na(df_sample) & df_sample != "") > 0), with = FALSE]

# Add "Seed noise" column: unique IDs from 1 to N
df_sample[, `Seed noise` := seq_len(.N)]


# Save the sampled data as a TAB-separated file
fwrite(
  df_sample,
  "Canada_main_MC_MCMC_sample_frac.tab",
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote = FALSE
)

# Display first few rows of the sampled data
head(df_sample)

```
